entities.name: Pierre Van Reyschoot
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pierre Van Reysschoot was a Belgian ice hockey player. He won a silver medal at the Ice Hockey European Championship 1927, and finished 5th and 13th at the 1928 and 1936 Winter Olympics, respectively.
